scope: Source extraction readiness only; not a verified SXM profile
selection_basis: Official manufacturer manual/support listing; representative current and explicitly requested legacy models, not sales ranking
notes: Detailed official 14-page MIDI chart has Note/CC bytes, Shift and pad modes, relative encoders, paired MSB/LSB tempo and LED colors. Ready means extraction may begin; source anomalies require a review queue.

coverage.addresses: numeric decimal and hex input/output tables throughout pp1-14
coverage.channels: chart uses zero-based channel nibble: Deck1 91/B1 = human channel2, shifted 94/B4 = human channel5; do not use printed 1 as human channel1
coverage.layers: Shift changes deck/mixer channel; pads use mode-dependent note ranges, pp2-4 and 12-14
coverage.encoders: p1 Autoloop CC0E relative 7F..40 CCW / 01..3F CW; p2 jog and 14-bit tempo CC08+CC28
coverage.led_feedback: p4/p14 RGB palette and pp7-8 meters/individual LEDs

inspected_locators: midi.pdf: pp1-14; p1 D1-1 Play 91 07 00/7F; p2 tempo/jog; p14 palette visually inspected
Source anomalies: p2 Centre backlight blank address; jog touch B1 08 overlaps tempo coarse CC08; resolve against hardware/manufacturer before final profile
midi.pdf: PDF page2 visually checked; blank Centre LED address and B1 08 jog-touch/tempo overlap confirmed in original rendering (inspection/anomalies.png)
